entity.description: Hears the Slack new-message event of the POC Studio Live Slack connection. Ignores bots and the bot's own messages. Four branches: the bot joined a channel (link its use case rows and say so), the bot was tagged at the top of a channel (the POC Studio Agent answers in a thread), a reply in a manager question thread (the agent answers in the thread), and an owner's 'approve' reply under a gate post (calls Approve gate).
